name: A turn that leaves its tests failing is a failure
why: VISION.md hero moment 2 and BEHAVIORS.md §3.1: a turn whose last test, build or deploy command failed finishes failed, and gets the annoyed mumble in every mode, which names the topic (steering.md, Writing) or grumbles "ugh" as in VISION.md; one whose last run passed is a normal finish

expect: agent finished → react(feeling: annoyed, word: tests|ugh)
